writing-skill.note: Clean and honest but flat voice; consoling 18km-vs-8km ending feels tidy and expected.

merged.note: Strong self-implication (cocky pacing, lowballing pain scores); bib-by-fruit-bowl ending lands quietly. Voice slightly plainer than D.

baseline.note: Lovely kelpie thread and stone image, but closing nod and list rhythms feel a touch engineered.

storyscope.note: Vivid local specifics, real humour, unresolved deferral-deadline ending; sounds most like an actual person's blog.
